ios.desc:
Turn Sunday's sermon into a week of devotion with Serma!

Turn your weekly sermon into a personal devotion plan.
Each day, read a new Scripture passage, spend a few quiet moments in prayer, and reflect on how God is speaking to you.
Stay consistent with gentle reminders and track your journey as your faith grows stronger, one reflection at a time.
